coordinate_convention: Zero-based, top-left origin, row-major 3 columns x 4 rows. Rectangles are grid cells including original separators; not production crop bounds.
fallback_policy: Resolve character ID and selected appearance first.
Use a visually supported compatible frame; ambiguous labels require narrative review.
If unavailable, use frame_00 of the SAME appearance as a proposed baseline.
If the appearance or baseline is absent, return unresolved; never substitute another appearance or character.
